kind: Scoped account lifecycle across ordinary browser, HTTPS API and native CLI

first_failures.result: Native account-create was unknown at starting commit; final 16-step native CLI lifecycle replays creation, update, rotation, revocation, stale/changed-meaning refusal and current status.

Two browser managers rotating each other reproduced SQLSTATE 40P01. Acquire partner serialization before authentication locks; original test now requires one commit and one authority refusal and passes under race.

First aggregate stopped on custody fuzz context deadline at 5.08 seconds after 205205 executions. Final original command passes with unchanged five-second budget, two workers and assertions; intermittent timing cause remains open.

mechanisms: Manager requires root mount, admin and accounts_manage; same tenant/partner and another target; old/new grants cannot exceed manager authority.

One normalized typed command and stable key across UI/API/CLI; current account revision, immutable original retry receipt, exact event/definition/result projection, atomic rollback and deferred completeness.
SELECT-only credential runtime; isolated NOLOGIN non-owner non-BYPASSRLS trigger role with fixed path, forced row policies and live safety checks.
Label-only updates preserve authority. Credential/access/expiry/revocation changes increment authority and atomically revoke at most eight admitted live browser sessions with linked manager events.
Ordinary authentication checks expiry; browser lifetime is capped by parent expiry. Rotation preserves SSH key registration and cannot revive expiry; revocation is terminal.

Browser saves generated 64-character credential before proof-only dispatch. CLI accepts protected new-token references or the same digest contract. Plaintext credential is absent from management request/receipt; login still uses it over TLS.

govulncheck.assessment: Retains module-only GO-2026-5932 in legacy x/crypto/OpenPGP outside imported packages; not release/image or complete security qualification.

npm_audit.scope: Full exact current production and development dependency lock.

gitleaks.scope: Default rules unchanged; this exact intermediate source/doc snapshot and 18 reachable commits. Final evidence metadata and new commit are rescanned separately in private verification.

limits: All 83 complete parity rows and 12 product journeys remain open. Same-host assisted exercises do not establish independent adoption, enterprise readiness or production safety.
First-admin/tenant/partner setup, invitations, SSO/MFA/IdP, self-service SSH key enrollment/overlap, delegated human approval and complete lifecycle remain open.
Native expiry checks here use ordinary credential/browser paths; the stock SFTP suite passes, but a complete native SSH-expiry/rotation journey and wider clients/platforms remain required.
Account admission is a bounded development profile including revoked rows; scalable configurable quotas, retention, reconstruction and governed rebind/recovery remain open.

Browser buffers are cleared best effort; browser-managed strings/Blob/download copies have no guaranteed immediate zeroization contract. API callers must generate strong credentials; a hash does not prove their entropy.
The earlier fuzz deadline remains D043 with unassigned timing cause despite the unchanged final gate passing. Endurance/performance and broad scheduling remain open.

Positive signed-browser path, actual malware detection/private crypto operations/business receipts, independent platforms, CI execution, release/image security and disconnected deployment remain open. X05/X06 remain pending. No model or scanner engine/database was loaded, and nothing was pushed.
